thread:
maria: I opened a PR updating audit export doc with a short pseudonymization example and EU residency wording. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/459
jon: Can we recommend retention ranges instead of hard TTLs? Legal prefers ranges.
maria: Drafted a table in the PR: short=30 days, default=1 year, archival=7 years. Open to phrasing.
samir: Please avoid phrasing that implies unilateral deletion. Suggest: "Retention is configurable per-tenant and subject to law/contract." Also call out pseudonymization vs anonymization.
arjun: Can someone add a Go SDK snippet showing a pseudonymize hook? I'll validate locally.
maria: Added a compact snippet in the PR body:
```go
// export with pseudonymize hook
client.Export(ctx, ExportOpts{
  Query: "resource:api_call",
  TransformFunc: func(ev Event) Event {
    if s, ok := ev.Fields["email"].(string); ok {
      ev.Fields["email"] = pseudonymize(s)
    }
    RedactField(&ev, "ip")
    return ev
  },
})
```
jon: Rename Transformer -> TransformFunc matches SDK. Nice.
arjun: Minor fix: RedactField needs pointer to ev or returns new event; I pushed a small patch.
docs-bot: Linkcheck failed: missing anchor #pseudonymization-example
maria: Fixed heading id and force-pushed the snippet patch from arjun.
samir: LGTM for legal wording except replace "we will delete" with "customers may configure deletion or retention in accordance with their contract and applicable law." Also add "we pseudonymize identifiers when feasible prior to export." 
jon: Add a short migration note for teams moving from flat JSON to structured events + a curl sample.
maria: Added migration note + curl example in PR body.
